note: Curated, well-known password wordlists. Times are rough estimates for this tool's one-attempt-per-open testing; the browser .7z path is slower and GPU tools (hashcat) are far faster. Estimates are for the raw list, before rule kits expand it.

lists.name: Top 1,000 common passwords
lists.description: The 1,000 most common passwords. A fast first pass that catches the laziest, most predictable choices. Run this before anything else.

lists.name: Top 10,000 common passwords
lists.description: The 10,000 most common passwords. A sensible default: broad enough to catch most weak passwords, small enough to finish quickly.

lists.name: Probable Top 12,000
lists.description: Real breach passwords sorted by how often they actually appear, not alphabetically. High hit rate for its size, and it matches how this tool already orders candidates.

lists.name: Top 100,000 common passwords
lists.description: The 100,000 most common passwords. Broader coverage for when the smaller lists miss. Still finishes in a reasonable time on this tool.

lists.name: Top 1,000,000 common passwords
lists.description: The classic one-million most common passwords. Thorough, but expect a long run on this tool. For a list this size, the hashcat path is usually the better choice.

lists.name: rockyou.txt (full)
lists.description: The famous list of ~14.3 million real passwords from the 2009 RockYou breach, the long-standing default for password cracking. Far too large for this tool's one-at-a-time testing. Download it and run it through hashcat instead.

lists.name: Weakpass (compiled lists)
lists.description: Large compiled and curated wordlists, from hundreds of MB to tens of GB. GPU cracking territory only, listed here for when you move to the hashcat path.
